title: Novel Antioxidant Quinazoline Sulfonamide Derivatives Acting Through NQO1 Induction and Their Radiation-Based Biodistribution Studies.
authors: Ghorab, Mostafa M; Soliman, Aiten M; Higgins, Maureen; Dinkova-Kostova, Albena T; Amin, Mohamed A; Korany, Mohamed; Khedr, Mohammed A; Sakr, Tamer M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型抗氧化剂喹唑啉磺酰胺衍生物通过NQO1诱导激活Nrf2通路，分子对接与MD模拟仅针对小分子与Keap1蛋白结合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: A series of quinazoline derivatives 5-19 bearing a benzenesulfonamide moiety and different acetamide side chains, including aromatic and heterocyclic groups, were designed, synthesized and confirmed structurally by microanalytical and spectral data. The obtained compounds were evaluated in vitro for their ability to activate nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) through induction of NAD(P)H: quinone oxidoreductase 1 (NQO1) in Hepa1c1c7 murine hepatoma cells. Compounds 15 and 18 exhibited the highest potency with CD values of 2.5 and 5 microM, respectively. The most potent derivatives (15 and 18) were further evaluated for their antioxidant potential using DPPH, with compound 18 demonstrating the highest radical scavenging activity. A radiation-based biodistribution study was conducted using 18 and displayed marked selectivity toward tumor cells over normal cells. Molecular docking studies and molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated that 18 exhibits a strong binding affinity and forms key stabilizing interactions within the Nrf2-binding domain of Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1). These results demonstrate that quinazoline sulfonamide derivatives are promising oxidative stress modulators with tumor targeting ability.
abstract_zh: 设计并合成了一系列含有苯磺酰胺部分和不同乙酰氨基侧链（包括芳香族和杂环基团）的喹唑啉衍生物5-19，并通过微量分析和光谱数据对其结构进行了确认。对所获得的化合物进行了体外评估，以检测其通过诱导Hepa1c1c7小鼠肝癌细胞中NAD(P)H：醌氧化还原酶1（NQO1）来激活核因子红细胞2相关因子2（Nrf2）的能力。化合物15和18表现出最高效力，其CD值分别为2.5和5微摩尔。对最具效力的衍生物（15和18）进一步使用DPPH评估了其抗氧化潜力，其中化合物18表现出最高的自由基清除活性。使用18进行了基于辐射的生物分布研究，并显示出对肿瘤细胞相对于正常细胞的显著选择性。分子对接研究和分子动力学模拟表明，18在Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）的Nrf2结合域内表现出强结合亲和力，并形成关键的稳定相互作用。这些结果表明，喹唑啉磺酰胺衍生物是具有肿瘤靶向能力的有前景的氧化应激调节剂。
